title: Giraffe waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x="40" y="40" width="14" height="40" rx="6" fill="#f2b64c"/>
  <rect x="40" y="48" width="14" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <rect x="40" y="56" width="14" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <rect x="40" y="64" width="14" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="78" rx="22" ry="14" fill="#f6c45a"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="78" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#c98a2e" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="82" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#c98a2e" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="32" y="86" width="7" height="12" rx="3" fill="#e8a83c"/>
  <rect x="48" y="86" width="7" height="12" rx="3" fill="#e8a83c"/>
  <rect x="32" y="94" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#b5792a"/>
  <rect x="48" y="94" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#b5792a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="32" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#f6c45a"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="38" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#f7d98a"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="39" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="39" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#3a5a3a"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#3a5a3a"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="29.5" r="0.8" fill="#c8f0c8"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="29.5" r="0.8" fill="#c8f0c8"/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x="39" y="18" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#e8a83c"/>
  <rect x="51" y="18" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#e8a83c"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="17" r="3" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="17" r="3" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="25" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#f2b64c" transform="rotate(-20 32 25)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="25" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#f2b64c" transform="rotate(20 62 25)"/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d="M63 71 Q76 62 80 48" stroke="#e8a83c" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="81" cy="45" r="5" fill="#f6c45a"/>
  <path d="M78 41 L83 38 M83 42 L88 40 M81 45 L87 45 M79 48 L84 50" stroke="#f6c45a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d="M30 72 Q24 70 20 74" stroke="#e8a83c" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M69 76 Q76 78 74 86" stroke="#e8a83c" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="87" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <!-- spots on neck -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="3" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="61" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#c98a2e"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="70" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#c98a2e"/>
</svg>
